usage.callShape: POST https://anthropic.yeetful.com/api/mcp/mcp with JSON-RPC body {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"ask_claude","arguments":{"prompt":"..."}}} and header Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

arguments.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.

usage.outputShape: SSE response; parse the `data:` line as JSON, then read result.content[0].text (text content of result.content[])
quirks: MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint - body MUST be a JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call request, not a plain chat payload
MUST send header Accept: application/json, text/event-stream or the server returns 406 'Not Acceptable' AFTER charging payment (first attempt was charged $0.01 then 406)
Response is SSE-framed (content-type text/event-stream): a line 'event: message' then 'data: {...json...}'; you must strip the 'data: ' prefix and JSON-parse to get the result
Two tools: ask_claude takes {prompt, system?} (single-prompt); claude_chat takes {messages:[{role,content}], system?} (multi-turn)
Output capped at 256 tokens; model and max_tokens are server-controlled and cannot be overridden
Price $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453); 402 payment-required header carries a bazaar extension documenting the exact body shape
qa-pay reported confirmed:false / txHash:null but call returned 200 with valid content
usage.guide: This is a Claude Haiku 4.5 LLM exposed over MCP Streamable HTTP via x402 ($0.01/call USDC on Base). POST to the URL a JSON-RPC 2.0 request: method tools/call, params.name = ask_claude (single prompt) or claude_chat (multi-turn messages), with your prompt in params.arguments. You MUST set the request header Accept: application/json, text/event-stream — otherwise the server charges you then returns 406. The 200 response is an SSE stream; take the line starting with 'data: ', JSON-parse the remainder, and read the model's answer at result.content[0].text. Output is capped at 256 tokens.
